items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Didn't you played with Jack Aaron's band? Yes, I did.

ctx.x: You know, he wants to know some other bands you played with. Didn't you played with Jack Aaron's band? Yes, I did. Well, tell him who was in the band. And you played, didn't you played with the, what's that, the Spades there, the Ace of Spades or the Williams and them out in California, and you played the Black and Tam Orchestra? Yeah, yeah, yeah, Corey Williams. Didn't you, huh?
Well, that's what he's asking. Yes, don't bother you by detail, but just to get a few of those bands that you mentioned is good. Yeah.
